notes: Item 19 is present and extensive. Three main disclosure tables: (1) Net Sales for 5 company + 18 franchised locations across 2023/2024/2025 with averages and medians; (2) Initial Investment + Net Sales for 12 franchise-owned locations opened post-Aug 2020; (3) EBITDA and expense breakdown by quartile for 22 restaurants in 2025. Also includes a percentage-of-sales table and a service-category distribution table. The quartile tables cover all 22 reporting restaurants (company and franchised combined); company-owned locations have imputed royalties/ad fees as if they were franchise-owned. Duplicate EBITDA % record for Q1 removed — retained as 'other' metric_name records only. Note: the page 49 table heading contains typos ('QUAARTILES', 'CALEDAR') which are OCR/document artifacts, not extraction errors. The 1st-gen site average and median initial investment are both $988,500, likely because only one 1st-gen site (Laveen at $938,500 or Tempe at $908,700) met criteria — slight discrepancy suggests the $988,500 may include the franchise fee added per note (2). West El Paso (opened 25-Jul) has no net sales data for any reported year (all *).
